quote.text: Gutta cavat lapidem, consumitur anulus usu.
quote.english: A drop hollows the stone; a ring is worn away by use.

poem.note: Written the summer he was ordained. Not published until 1918, twenty-nine years after he died; he had shown it to almost no one.

song.title: Peace Piece
song.note: One left-hand figure, held for seven minutes, improvised in a single take at the end of a session.
